profile.name: SHFQC量子控制器
profile.description: 这是一台面向量子计算实验的高频量子控制与读出仪器，集成信号发生、AWG/序列器、触发、波形存储、积分权重、读出和结果记录等功能，可用于量子比特或量子多能级态实验中的微波脉冲生成、序列控制与测量读出。
profile.description_en: This is a high-frequency quantum control and readout instrument for quantum computing experiments. It integrates signal generation, AWG/sequencer control, triggering, waveform memory, integration weights, readout, and result logging for microwave pulse generation, sequence control, and measurement readout of qubits or qudits.
